meta.name: image-to-video
meta.description: Still-to-video conversion guide: model selection, motion prompting, and camera movement. Covers Wan 2.5 i2v, Seedance, Fabric, Grok Video with when to use each. Use for: animating images, creating video from stills, adding motion, product animations. Triggers: image to video, i2v, animate image, still to video, add motion to image, image animation, photo to video, animate still, wan i2v, image2video, bring image to life, animate photo, motion from image

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将静态图片转为动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把照片或图片变成有动态效果的视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn static images into dynamic videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to animate photos or images into videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的图片和文字描述，通过命令行工具生成动画视频。它会帮你选择合适的模型（如 Wan 2.5 i2v、Seedance 等），并指导你添加镜头运动、主体动作等效果。
howto.when: 当你要求将静态图片转为视频，或提到“图片转视频”、“i2v”、“给图片加动效”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这张风景图变成视频，湖面要有涟漪。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Wan 2.5 i2v 模型生成动画。

say.text: 给这张产品图做一个缓慢环绕的镜头。
让这张布料图片中的织物飘动起来。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate animated videos from still images and text descriptions using a command-line tool. It helps select the right model (e.g., Wan 2.5 i2v, Seedance) and guides adding camera movement, subject motion, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert a still image to video, or mention keywords like 'image to video', 'i2v', 'animate image', etc.

say_en.text: Turn this landscape image into a video with ripples on the lake.
say_en.note: Claude will use Wan 2.5 i2v model to generate animation.

say_en.text: Create a slow orbiting camera around this product image.
say_en.note: Claude will use Seedance 2.0 with orbital motion.

say_en.text: Make the fabric in this cloth image flow.
say_en.note: Claude will use Fabric 1.0 model for physics-based flow.
